name: UPSC — Apply
instructions: UPSC needs a one-time Universal Registration (OTR), then a Common Application Form per recruitment. Logs in through upsconline. Photo and signature are size-checked; payment, if any, is always done by you. Fills from your profile first (no AI for known questions), asks you only for codes (OTP), passwords, captchas and anything new, pauses for your review, then submits. For Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification it asks you for the number, consent and OTP/PIN in chat and types them in (never saved). Payments are always done by you.

starterActionPlan.description: Register or sign in: fills your details, asks for OTP, password and captcha
Fill every page of the application (details, education, photo, signature, declaration)
